SELECT
    centreid AS cog_centreid,
    name                       AS name,
    city                       AS address1_city,
    physical_address           AS address1_line1,
    email                      AS emailaddress1,
    phone_number               AS telephone1,
    start_date                 AS cog_centrestartdate,
    capacity                   AS cog_learnercapacity,
    classrooms                 AS cog_classroomcount,
    ecd_type                   AS cog_ecdtypecode,
    agreement_type             AS cog_agreementtypecode,
    updated_at                 AS cog_giraffeupdatedon,
    created_at                 AS overriddencreatedon,
    grow_programme             AS cog_programme,   
    programme_status           AS cog_programmestatuscode,
    countrycode                AS cog_countryid,
    regioncode                 AS cog_region,
    property_type              AS cog_propertytypecode,
    centre_type                AS cog_centretypecode,
    class_types                AS cog_classtypecode,
    operating_hours            AS cog_operatinghours
FROM growecd.centres
WHERE updated_at >= '@{pipeline().parameters.WatermarkDate}'
  AND updated_at < CURDATE()
  AND is_test != 1;

source.query:
SELECT
    countrycode  AS cog_countrycode,   -- make this the alternate key and upsert on it
    country      AS cog_name
FROM growecd.countries;

SELECT
    l.centreid AS cog_centreid,
    c.name     AS cog_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND 1 THEN 1 END) AS cog_learners0to2,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 1 END) AS cog_learners2to5,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 6 AND 8 THEN 1 END) AS cog_learners6to9,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) >= 9            THEN 1 END) AS cog_learners9plus,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) >= 0            THEN 1 END) AS cog_learnerstotal
FROM growecd.learners AS l
LEFT JOIN growecd.centres AS c
       ON c.centreid = l.centreid
WHERE COALESCE(l.archived, 0) <> 1
  AND COALESCE(c.is_test, 0) <> 1
GROUP BY l.centreid, c.name
ORDER BY l.centreid;

SELECT
    countrycode  AS cog_country,
    region AS cog_name,
regioncode AS cog_regioncode
FROM growecd.regions;

SELECT
    a.attendanceid            AS cog_giraffeid,
    a.eventid                 AS cog_trainingeventid,
    a.updated_at              AS cog_giraffeupdatedon,
    a.created_at              AS overriddencreatedon,
    a.profileid               AS cog_contact,
    a.centreid                AS cog_centreid,
    a.userid                  AS cog_applicationuser,
    a.attendeeid              AS cog_attendeeid,
    a.centre_name             AS cog_centrename,
    a.countrycode             AS cog_countryid,
    a.regioncode              AS cog_region,
    a.usertype                AS cog_usertype,
    a.recorded_mobilenumber   AS cog_recordedmobilenumber,
    a.recorded_email          AS cog_recordedemail,
    a.status                  AS cog_attendancestatuscode,
    a.absence_reason          AS cog_absencereason,
    a.usertype                AS cog_roleateventcode
FROM growecd.cms_event_attendance AS a
INNER JOIN growecd.cms_events AS e
        ON e.eventid = a.eventid
WHERE LEFT(e.title, 18) = 'Accelerator_Module'
  AND a.updated_at >= '@{formatDateTime(pipeline().parameters.WatermarkDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')}'
  AND a.updated_at <  CURDATE()

SELECT
    year_introduced          AS cog_yearintroduced,
    category                    AS cog_category,
    eventmasterid               AS cog_giraffeid,
    eventtypeid               AS  cog_eventtypeid,
    course_name                      AS cog_name,
    updated_at                AS cog_giraffeupdatedon,
    created_at                AS overriddencreatedon   

FROM growecd.cms_event_master
WHERE updated_at >= '@{pipeline().parameters.WatermarkDate}'
  AND updated_at < CURDATE();

SELECT
    requires_course_name      AS cog_requirescoursename,
    requires_category         AS cog_requirescategory,
    eventtypeid               AS cog_giraffeid,
    name                      AS cog_name,
    updated_at                AS cog_giraffeupdatedon,
    created_at                AS overriddencreatedon   

FROM growecd.cms_event_types
WHERE updated_at >= '@{pipeline().parameters.WatermarkDate}'
  AND updated_at < CURDATE();

SELECT
    title                     AS cog_name,
    event_date                AS cog_eventdate,
    eventid                   AS cog_giraffeid,
    eventmasterid             AS cog_eventmasterid,
    updated_at                AS cog_giraffeupdatedon,
    created_at                AS overriddencreatedon,   
    facilitator               AS cog_facilitator, 
    venue                     AS cog_venue  

FROM growecd.cms_events
WHERE updated_at >= '@{pipeline().parameters.WatermarkDate}'
  AND updated_at < CURDATE();
